name: Popover
description: A popover: rich content (a title, text, links, images, buttons) in a box with an arrow next to a trigger, opened by a click or by hovering or focusing the trigger. A non-modal dialog in the top layer, placed on any side of the trigger and flipped when there is no room.
import: import { Popover, PopoverBody, PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle } from "@stefan-florescu/ui";
useWhen: Showing more about something on hover or click, such as a user or company profile
Explaining a term, a chart or a setting next to it, with links to read more
Showing live feedback next to a field, such as password strength
avoidWhen: A short text label for an icon button: use aria-label (or a tooltip)
A list of actions or options: use Dropdown
Content people must act on before continuing: use Modal
Information that must always be visible: put it on the page
